notes.title: To mark 10 years this indie game changes price every hour to London's temperature
notes.notes: As far as publicity stunts and indie dev anniversary celebrations go, this is both clever and quite amusing for A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/to-mark-10-years-this-indie-game-changes-price-every-hour-to-londons-temperature/
